notes: Final check scope: read-only review of the working tree of the B1 branch (HEAD 2390cc3 WIP plus 20 modified tracked files and 1 untracked file, measured before this record was rewritten). The only file edited is this record. Builds, logs and scratch are under out2/recheck: src is a copy with .git excluded; base is git archive of 825d6c7; the cold and warm store builds use their own cache folders.

F1 (BLOCKING, fix before merge): the four CompareTests in tests/test_hail.py (line 1332, skipUnless has_pyarrow) are skipped in the default interpreter (unittest: OK (skipped=4)), and the website workflow installs no pyarrow (.github/workflows/website.yml line 83: requests jinja2 pillow numpy pygrib h5py), so the B1-5 compare-gate tests never run in CI. With the venv interpreter (which has pyarrow) the four run and pass, and the full suite runs 585 tests with no skips (Ran 585 tests in 104.541s, OK). Fix: add pyarrow to the install line at .github/workflows/website.yml:83.

F2 (non-blocking, provenance): the store used for the real build (out2/store/store, built 12:42:28 UTC) has as_of 2026-10-16 (ledger/run.json window; fetch ledger ends at stamp 20261017). The bucket lists CONUS/MESH_Max_1440min_00.50/20261018/MRMS_MESH_Max_1440min_00.50_20261018-120000.grib2.gz (LastModified 2026-10-18T12:08:17Z) and the builder's default end now gives 2026-10-17; run.json does not record the requested end. Fix: rebuild the measurement store with the defaults (a default-end build in this check gives as_of 2026-10-17) and write the requested end into run.json.

F3 (non-blocking, decision 3; C6 still open): website/hail.py SAMPLE_EVENTS lists selected cells per day, so on the fixture's own days the fixture holds 57 events where the real store holds 1,575 for the same three tiles and days (r0079_c0198: 11 vs 621; r0079_c0199: 39 vs 792; r0092_c0214: 7 vs 162). Every stored value is real (0 mismatches) and the state lists equal the store's. Fix: generate SAMPLE_EVENTS from every real event of the three tiles on the listed days (about 1,575 entries, a few kilobytes, far under 50 KB), or record a supervisor ruling that the sample is a partial illustration.

F4 (non-blocking, operational; C7 still open): website.yml lines 97-98 pass --hail-history with --require-live to every non-main build, and the hail-store release asset does not exist until hail-store.yml has run once, so branch builds fail until then. Fix: run hail-store.yml once (workflow_dispatch), confirm the release asset, then push the branch.

F5 (supervisor ruling; C10 still open): added lines name a branch with the agent prefix in docs/DECISIONS.md (two lines), docs/ROADMAP.md (one line) and this record; the base already uses the same prefix in README.md, docs/DECISIONS.md and docs/ROADMAP.md. Not changed. Ruling needed: whether branch names fall under the rule on AI-product names in repo files.

F6 (supervisor ruling; round 3 docs note): brief product item 2 asks for the popup sentence 'No radar estimate on other days is not no hail' (quoted with the brief's quote marks); map.json words (lead_none and related) and the what-this-is words do not carry it, and the brief's Words section has different text. Ruling needed; no code change until ruled.

F7 (not verified; C8 still open): /usr/bin/python3.12 parses website/hail.py, website/build.py and website/sources.py (ast.parse ok). No Python 3.12 interpreter here has numpy, pygrib or pyarrow, so the unit suite and a store build were not run on 3.12. Fix: run the unit suite and one store build on 3.12 in CI and compare the shard sha256 values with the 3.13 build.

Refuted RF2: tests delete outside their own folders: 37 rmtree and 3 unlink calls in tests/ (test_site 23 rmtree; test_hail 12 rmtree and 3 unlink; test_updates 1; test_weather 1); each acts on a mkdtemp folder or on a copy the test made. No os.remove and no rm -rf.

Refuted RF4: tiles or state lists are wrong: the 4,597 tiles that hold Montana cells each have a shard, 0 state-list mismatches against the mask, 0 non-integer entries; the index tiles list equals the expected names.
Refuted RF5: the fixture's values are not real: all 57 fixture events equal the store's values (0 mismatches); F3 is about completeness only.

Refuted RF6: the newest day does not re-decode: SPC 2026-10-16 (file 20261017) decodes 14 cells at or above the floor, 14 stored, 0 mismatches; SPC 2026-10-17 (file 20261018) decodes 7, 7 stored, 0 mismatches (cold store).
Refuted RF7: the flag-off build differs in more than map.js and one map.html line: diff -rq shows only those two files; map.css and the 89 other files are byte-identical.

Refuted RF8: forbidden terms or unfilled braces in the hail text: none in the 14 town hail blocks or the About hail text. The 'clear' hits are in the alerts and weather blocks outside the hail section; 'no hail' and 'dry' occur only in negations or in base text; map.json word templates carry braces by design and are filled in the browser.
Refuted RF9: a SAMPLE label on real hail text: none in the real build's hail blocks; the page-level sample banner comes from the --sample flag for the other feeds.
Refuted RF10: pins in the daily job or the tests (decision 13): none; hail-store.yml uses pip install numpy pygrib requests.
Refuted RF11: the daily job needs packages it does not install: hail.py imports only the standard library at module level; numpy, pygrib and requests are imported lazily.
Refuted RF12: the tests write into the source tree: after the full unit run the copy equals the worktree (only .git excluded).
Refuted RF13: a failed tile fetch is cached for the page's life: hailTile deletes the rejected promise, so the next click asks again.
Refuted RF14: the daily job passes an explicit end: hail-store.yml runs build without --end.
Refuted RF15: the Colorado check accepts either outside or no-estimate words (C9): check_hail requires the outside words and no request.

Refuted RF16: the cold build and the earlier 12:42 build disagree: an event-level comparison gives 0 changed values, and 7 events exist only in the cold store, all on 2026-10-17. The byte-level cold versus warm comparison is in B1-6 and agrees.

Not checked: B1-4 (B2 join), the B2 and B3 gates, a Chromium click on a town bubble (decision 8; code only), the cold versus warm result on Python 3.12 (F7), the NOAA publication timing risk beyond the documented 12:43 UTC start (D34 known limits).

Finishing pass, 2026-10-18: items 1 to 6 of the finishing brief were applied in the working tree on top of e3b6bf0 (HEAD at the start of this pass). The Website install step now adds pyarrow (the F1 fix; not yet run in CI). website/hail.py adds the day-not-listed sentence to what_this_is, writes requested_end to ledger/run.json, and builds SAMPLE_EVENTS from every real event of each fixture tile on the SPC days that tile lists: 1,575 events in 290 cells, taken from the real store (the F3 fix). The three tests that assumed an in-state cell had no events now use a Billings cell (45.755, -108.575) and the first empty Billings key. The DESIGN.md and DECISIONS.md D34 wording follows items 2, 5 and 6. The copy-check sentence for the store as of 2026-10-16 already reads as the finishing brief asks; the store as of 2026-10-17 keeps its own count (238 days from 2021-10-18). recheck.fixture (57 events, 3,639 bytes) was measured before this pass and is kept as the record of that measurement. go_live_2026_10_21.main_build: --hail-history without --require-live: a failed store download leaves the pages saying the history is unavailable and the rest of the site publishes.
go_live_2026_10_21.asset: named after the branch whose job publishes it (hail-store-main.tar.gz for main; slashes as dashes), one store run per branch at a time; the new file goes up under a temporary name and takes the asset's name only once complete; each build reads its own branch's asset through HAIL_STORE_ASSET and falls back to main's only when its own is not published (HTTP 404); any job that finds the earlier shared-name asset hail-store.tar.gz (which the later stages' branch jobs had written with the address stage's data) removes it, and a failed listing or removal fails the job.
go_live_2026_10_21.wait: a branch preview waits up to 60 minutes (the store job's cap) for the branch's latest store run (the actions: read scope); it fails when the run for its commit did not succeed, could not be listed or is still running; main never waits; tested under bash with a stub gh; the build job's timeout is 75 minutes on a branch and 15 on main.
go_live_2026_10_21.stale: a real store older than STALE_DAYS (3) counts as a failed source (the pages keep the stale line); the SAMPLE fixture is exempt; tested.
